notes: 501(c)(3) founded 2001 (Kathy Stevens); 100+ acre Hudson Valley refuge ~100 mi north of NYC, 5,000+ rescues over 25 years. Provides lifelong refuge to ten species of farmed animals - cows, pigs, sheep, goats, HORSES, chickens, turkeys, ducks and others - rescued from cruelty/neglect. Out-of-city (Saugerties) - logged as REGIONAL intake, not NYC-local. Verify current intake capacity before referral; sanctuaries fill quickly. Intake: general inquiries info@CASanctuary.org Intake: 316 Old Stage Rd, Saugerties
